name: MACS J1141.6-1905 (Hubble)
blurb: MACS J1141.6-1905, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: macsj114161905-hubble
story: A crowd of galaxies held together by gravity, around four billion light-years away. Hubble searched here for distant galaxies whose light is gravitationally lensed by the cluster.

claims.text: MACS J1141.6-1905 is a galaxy cluster
MACS J1141.6-1905 is around four billion light-years away
The programs looked for distant galaxies gravitationally lensed by the cluster
It is one of the most massive, very X-ray luminous clusters in the MACS snapshot survey
